				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_EMPEROR"
					value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"
				}
				add = {
					desc = "IO_LEADER_DIP_REP"
					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.modifier:diplomatic_reputation
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = { desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE" value = 20 }
			}
		}
	}
	military_examination = {
		years = 2
		on_pay_price = {
			change_celestial_authority = { value = celestial_authority_very_strong_penalty }
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				leader_country ?= {
					add_political_influence = political_influence_ultimate_penalty
					add_gold = {
						value = this.monthly_income_trade_and_tax
						multiply = {
							value = -6
							add = {
								value = -1
								multiply = { value = international_organization:middle_kingdom.total_members divide = 10 }
							}
						}
						min = -100000
					}
				}
			}
		}
		potential = {
			international_organization_has_unlocked_policy_trigger = { type = military_examination }
		}
		country_modifier = {
			potential_trigger = {
				is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			}
			government_size = 1
			monthly_towards_quality = societal_value_minor_monthly_move
			monthly_army_tradition = 0.05
		}
		country_modifier = {
			potential_trigger = {
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					country_has_special_status = { type = special_status:celestial_governor country = root }
				}
			}
			monthly_army_tradition = 0.05
		}
		country_modifier = {
			potential_trigger = {
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					NOT = {
						country_has_special_status = { type = special_status:celestial_governor country = root }
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				}
			}
			monthly_army_tradition = 0.02
		}
		wants_this_policy_bias = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = { international_organization_has_leader = yes }
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_EMPEROR"
					value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"
				}
				add = {
					desc = "IO_LEADER_DIP_REP"
					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.modifier:diplomatic_reputation
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = { desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE" value = 20 }
			}
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:monastic_reformation_movement = {
	unique = yes
	law_category = religious
	potential = { has_variable = monastic_reformation_movement }
	locked = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = mos_monastic_reformation_decision.custom2
			has_variable = supported_monastic_reformation_movement
		}
	}
	non_possessors = {
		country_modifier = {
			estate_enrichment = -0.2
			monthly_religious_influence = -0.1
			monthly_towards_communalism = societal_value_minor_monthly_move
		}
		estate_preferences = { peasants_estate }
		years = 2
		on_activate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = { name = supported_monastic_reformation_movement value = yes years = 10 }
			}
		}
	}
	possessors = {
		country_modifier = {
			global_clergy_estate_power = 0.1
			monthly_towards_free_subjects = societal_value_minor_monthly_move
			global_peasants_max_literacy = 4
			global_soldiers_max_literacy = 4
			global_laborers_max_literacy = 4
		}
		estate_preferences = { clergy_estate }
		years = 2
		on_activate = {
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = { name = supported_monastic_reformation_movement value = yes years = 10 }
			}
		}
	}
}

	}

			monthly_political_influence_gain_modifier = 0.10
		}

		years = 2
	}
	free_press = {

			global_crown_estate_power = -0.1
			global_nobles_max_literacy = 10
			global_clergy_max_literacy = 10
			global_burghers_max_literacy = 10
			monthly_towards_liberalism = societal_value_monthly_move
			monthly_towards_individualism = societal_value_monthly_move
			monthly_towards_free_subjects = societal_value_monthly_move
			monthly_political_influence_gain_modifier = -0.10
		}
		estate_preferences = { burghers_estate }
		years = 2
	}
}

REPLACE:sect_school_law = {
	type = international_organization
	law_category = religious
	potential = {
		international_organization_type = international_organization_type:sect
		OR = {
			international_organization_has_policy = policy:nichiren_policy
			international_organization_has_policy = policy:nyigma_policy
			international_organization_has_policy = policy:kadam_policy
			international_organization_has_policy = policy:kagyu_policy
			international_organization_has_policy = policy:sakya_policy
			international_organization_has_policy = policy:jonang_policy
		}
	}
	allow = { }
	locked = { always = yes }
	nichiren_policy = {
		on_activate = { }
		on_deactivate = { }
		country_modifier = { global_pop_conversion_speed_modifier = 0.1 tolerance_heretic = 0.5 }
		country_modifier = {
			potential_trigger = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = disfavoring_sect_tt
					has_variable = disfavoring_sect
					exists = scope:recipient
					var:disfavoring_sect ?= { this = scope:recipient }
				}
			}
			global_pop_conversion_speed_modifier = -0.2
			tolerance_heretic = -1
		}
		country_modifier = {
			potential_trigger = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = promoting_sect_tt
					has_variable = promoting_sect
					exists = scope:recipient
					var:promoting_sect ?= {
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
				}
			}
			global_pop_conversion_speed_modifier = -0.15
			tolerance_heretic = -0.5
		}
	}
	jodou_shinshuu_policy = {
		on_activate = { }
		on_deactivate = { }
		country_modifier = { peasants_estate_target_satisfaction = medium_permanent_target_satisfaction }

					text = promoting_sect_tt

					exists = scope:recipient
					var:promoting_sect ?= {
						NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
					}
				}
			}

		}
	}
